scripts.mock:test: bun run mock & MOCK_PID=$!; trap 'kill $MOCK_PID 2>/dev/null' EXIT; sleep 2 && bun run test:api; STATUS=$?; kill $MOCK_PID 2>/dev/null; exit $STATUS
scripts.test:api: sh -c 'ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=allure-results-api bunx wdio run wdio.conf.ts --suite api ${SPEC:+--spec $SPEC}'
scripts.test: bun run test:api && bun run test:web
scripts.report:generate: bunx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report --config allurerc.mjs
scripts.report:api: bunx allure generate allure-results-api --clean -o allure-report --config allurerc.mjs
scripts.report:mobile: bunx allure generate allure-results-mobile --clean -o allure-report --config allurerc.mjs
scripts.report:all: bunx allure generate allure-results-api allure-results-mobile --clean -o allure-report --config allurerc.mjs
scripts.docker:install: docker compose run --rm test-runner bun install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.docker:test:web: docker compose run --rm test-runner sh -c 'bunx wdio run wdio.conf.ts --suite web ${SPEC:+--spec $SPEC}'
scripts.docker:test:api: docker compose run --rm test-runner sh -c 'bunx wdio run wdio.conf.ts --suite api ${SPEC:+--spec $SPEC}'
scripts.docker:test: bun run docker:test:api && bun run docker:test:web
scripts.docker:report: rm -rf allure-results && bun run docker:test && bun run report:generate
